overloads.semanticRole: The RESTART 4D command restarts the current 4D application.

constraints: time and message are only taken into account with server applications; they are ignored if executed in single-user or remote applications.
If time is omitted, the server waits up to 10 minutes for all client applications to disconnect before automatically disconnecting them.

Restart is combined with SET UPDATE FOLDER: if update information was specified in the current session, the new version designated by SET UPDATE FOLDER automatically replaces the current version at restart; otherwise, 4D simply restarts with the current structure and data files.
Sets the OK system variable to 1 if the command executed correctly, or 0 (and the application still restarts) otherwise.
